messages:
Rae M: quick heads-up — the weekly dashboard shows a bump in launch-post conversions and webinar-driven MQLs overnight. before we send to execs, can analytics + ops sanity-check? :wave:

Diego V: on it. quick look: streaming signups spike ~45%, CRM-accepted flat. could be sampling, a routing flip, or a messaging variant. sending initial checklist.

Elena S: we swapped the UTM sanitizer rule on 2024-07-11 at 04:05 UTC to capture partner tags; that might change how GA4 buckets sources. logging here in case it explains GA4 vs server delta.

Mark T: also note we did a short sample-rate increase on the front-end beacon 2024-07-11 03:50 UTC (15% -> 60%) to debug an impression loss. reverted 03:58 UTC. streaming widgets pulled raw counts during the test window.

Rae M: ok can we do three things? 1) analytics add a sample-normalized series and an annotation for the test; 2) ops run a matchback / dedupe job for 2024-07-10..2024-07-12; 3) growth slice by subject-line variant so we can isolate messaging lift.

Diego V: will add normalized series and annotation. SQL stub for normalization:
```sql
SELECT day, SUM(unique_visitors) / NULLIF(avg_sample_rate,0) AS normalized_visitors
FROM daily_beacon
WHERE day BETWEEN '2024-07-08' AND '2024-07-14'
GROUP BY day;
```

Mark T: kicked a matchback rerun: `airflow trigger_dag matchback_leads --conf '{"start":"2024-07-10","end":"2024-07-12"}'`. ETA ~80m. note: streaming ingestion had transient duplicate webhooks at 03:54 UTC; dedupe backfill will handle that.

Elena S: growth note: variant-X subject was used in the launch-post and webinar follow-up to a 30% subset. early open rate ~2.6x vs control. i'll export cohort flags and attach to the campaign doc so analytics can segment.

opsbot: matchback_leads DAG triggered by Mark T at 2024-07-11T04:20:10Z (run id: manual__2024-07-11T04:20:10).

Diego V: adding annotation to KPI board: "beacon sample-rate test 2024-07-11 03:50-03:58 UTC; normalized series added" (id: a-20240711-sample). also adding a deduped lead series using idempotency keys. SQL for dedupe:
```sql
SELECT event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(idempotency_key, event_id)) AS deduped_leads
FROM inbound_webhooks
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2024-07-10' AND '2024-07-12'
GROUP BY event_date;
```

Rae M: perfect. one more: please compute an "attribution_confidence" label for the daily KPI snapshot (high/medium/low) — low when only streaming spikes, medium when deduped streaming+partial CRM, high when streaming+crm align. want to avoid noisy exec pings.

Elena S: noted. i'll ingest the cohort flags and compute CTR->demo->accepted conversion for variant-X vs control and post to the campaign doc. if variant-X drove real upstream lift we should see higher accepted conversion after the 48h CRM lag.

dashbot: dashboard updated  added series "normalized_visitors" and "deduped_leads"; annotation id a-20240711-sample; public board: https://dash.redwood.com/r/kpi-weekly

Mark T: matchback backfill complete. I patched the streaming aggregator to apply dedupe and sample-normalization for historical slices. re-run summary: streaming spike reduced ~81% after dedupe and normalized counts align much closer to CRM. posting reconciled snapshot now.

Diego V: reconciled snapshot posted. quick summary for execs: "Observed streaming-only spike due to a short beacon sample-rate test and transient webhook retries. After dedupe+normalization, net MQL delta is <4% week-over-week; separate messaging variant-X likely drove a smaller but real increase in opens; CRM-accepted leads show a delayed lift consistent with variant cohort. Attribution confidence: medium."

Rae M: great summary — thanks. please paste the reconciled numbers and the short note to #marketing and include a link to the campaign variant export so PMs can review. avoiding noisy pings to execs was the point. :thumbsup:
